findings.title: Record the required whole-gate outcomes explicitly
findings.body: The closeout contract requires explicit `WHOLE_A91307` and `significantDecisionCoverage` values of `PASS` or `NOT_READY`. This record only supplies a generic `verdict: "PASS"`; its subordinate source/reader/quality fields cannot substitute for the required whole-criterion and coverage outcomes. Add both named fields and tie them to the actual covered original decision corpus before treating this as the A913-07 completion record.

overall_explanation: The documentation additions are broadly consistent with the stated reevaluation-field goal, but the proposed A913-07 closeout artifact omits required explicit whole-gate and coverage statuses.
